title: Emulator measurement scenario
description: An ordered list of phases or building blocks (docs/SCENARIOS.md)

poll_s.title: Poll
poll_s.description: How often conditions are evaluated while waiting (virtual s)

drain_s.title: Drain
drain_s.description: Packets sent in the last drain_s before an evaluation are not counted yet (s)

load.title: Load
load.description: The application load from the start of the phase ("off": none; omitted: as before)

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: up: routers to border router; down: border router to each router; mcast: border router to a group; p2p: router to router. Up, down and p2p are echoed

rate_pps.title: Rate
rate_pps.description: Offered packets per second of each flow, whole network

interval_s.title: Interval
interval_s.description: Instead of rate_pps: mean interval of each node (s)

max_rate_pps.title: Rate cap
max_rate_pps.description: With interval_s: at most this many packets/s, whole network (a light probe whatever the network size)

echo.title: Echo
echo.description: Targets answer, so that originators measure the RTT

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: A condition on the run, evaluated live at each poll (all fields but "is" depend on the kind)

is.title: Kind
is.description: immediately: true at once; time: virtual time reached; elapsed: time since the reference (the previous phase's end for a start, the phase's start for an end); formed: the network has joined; node_event: a node joined, changed or lost its parent, restarted; repaired: every node cut off by the last disruption has a route again; metric: a measured value compared with a threshold; all / any: a combination

t_s.title: Time
t_s.description: For time: virtual seconds since the run's start

fraction.title: Share of nodes
fraction.description: For formed: the share of the routers (or of nodes) that must have reached the milestone

milestone.title: Milestone
milestone.description: For formed (default ready) and node_event joined (default operational): operational (Wi-SUN join done) or ready (RPL routing ready; not repeated when an interface comes back up)

stable_s.title: Stable for
stable_s.description: For formed: and no parent change anywhere for this long (s)

e2e.title: End to end
e2e.description: For repaired: also every cut-off node is in the border router's routing table and got an echo for a packet sent after the disruption (needs a running echoed flow)

value.title: Value
value.description: For metric: the threshold (in the metric's unit); with relative_to, ignored

per_hop.title: Per hop count
per_hop.description: For metric (rtt, latency): true if the comparison holds for any hop count, each against the same hop count of relative_to

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: For traffic metrics: the flow (default: up, else the first one running)

window_s.title: Window
window_s.description: For metric: the trailing window of packets sent (s)

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Start when [start]; set [load]; do [actions]; measure [measure]; end when [end] (or repeat)

name.title: Name
name.description: Unique name, used by later phases

start.title: Start
start.description: When the phase starts (default: right after the previous phase). A condition, with a timeout and what to do when it expires

is.title: Kind
is.description: immediately: true at once; time: virtual time reached; elapsed: time since the reference (the previous phase's end for a start, the phase's start for an end); formed: the network has joined; node_event: a node joined, changed or lost its parent, restarted; repaired: every node cut off by the last disruption has a route again; metric: a measured value compared with a threshold; all / any: a combination

t_s.title: Time
t_s.description: For time: virtual seconds since the run's start

fraction.title: Share of nodes
fraction.description: For formed: the share of the routers (or of nodes) that must have reached the milestone

milestone.title: Milestone
milestone.description: For formed (default ready) and node_event joined (default operational): operational (Wi-SUN join done) or ready (RPL routing ready; not repeated when an interface comes back up)

stable_s.title: Stable for
stable_s.description: For formed: and no parent change anywhere for this long (s)

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Which nodes an action acts on, resolved from the topology when the action runs

select.title: Selection
select.description: id: one node; ids: a list; all: every router; hop: the routers at a hop count; br_children: the border router's children (hop 1); ancestor: the node at a hop count on the path of a given node; storey or area: by position (needs a positions file); label: the nodes an earlier action picked

hop.title: Hop count
hop.description: For select hop and ancestor: hops to the border router

of.title: Of node
of.description: For select ancestor: the node whose path is taken

storey.title: Storey
storey.description: For select storey: the FLOOR of the positions file (else Z / 3.5 m)

box.title: Area
box.description: For select area: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in metres

label.title: Label
label.description: For select label: the label of an earlier action

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: Among the candidates: all; largest_subtree or most_children (the worst case); random (drawn from the seed); fraction; first (lowest ID)

count.title: Count
count.description: How many to pick (largest_subtree, most_children, random, first)

fraction.title: Fraction
fraction.description: For pick fraction: the share of the candidates, drawn from the seed

e2e.title: End to end
e2e.description: For repaired: also every cut-off node is in the border router's routing table and got an echo for a packet sent after the disruption (needs a running echoed flow)

value.title: Value
value.description: For metric: the threshold (in the metric's unit); with relative_to, ignored

relative_to.title: Relative to
relative_to.description: The value is factor x the same metric (or another one) measured in an earlier phase

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: The earlier phase's metric (default: the condition's metric); a capacity search also has capacity_pps

per_hop.title: Per hop count
per_hop.description: For metric (rtt, latency): true if the comparison holds for any hop count, each against the same hop count of relative_to

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: For traffic metrics: the flow (default: up, else the first one running)

window_s.title: Window
window_s.description: For metric: the trailing window of packets sent (s)

timeout_s.title: Timeout
timeout_s.description: Give up waiting after this long (s)

on_timeout.title: On timeout
on_timeout.description: start: start anyway (flagged in the report); skip: skip this phase; abort: end the scenario

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Done in order at the start

items.title: Action
items.description: Something done at the start of the phase

do.title: Action
do.description: kill: power off; restart: power off and a fresh start; leave: the interface goes down (a graceful leave); cut_links: every link of the nodes (or to peers) cut; partition: links between groups a and b cut; degrade_links: every link of the nodes at rssi_dbm; interferer_add, interferer_remove: external interference (central medium); mark: a note in the logs

for_s.title: For
for_s.description: Undo after this long (s): restart the killed nodes, interface up, links back, interferer removed. Omitted: permanent

name.title: Name
name.description: For interferer_add and interferer_remove ("all": every one)

label.title: Label
label.description: Name of the nodes this action picked, for later selections (select label)

oneOf.title: Load
oneOf.description: The application load from the start of the phase ("off": none; omitted: as before)

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: up: routers to border router; down: border router to each router; mcast: border router to a group; p2p: router to router. Up, down and p2p are echoed

rate_pps.title: Rate
rate_pps.description: Offered packets per second of each flow, whole network

interval_s.title: Interval
interval_s.description: Instead of rate_pps: mean interval of each node (s)

max_rate_pps.title: Rate cap
max_rate_pps.description: With interval_s: at most this many packets/s, whole network (a light probe whatever the network size)

echo.title: Echo
echo.description: Targets answer, so that originators measure the RTT

load.title: Load
load.description: The load from this phase on: settings, "off", or "keep" (the default)

sets.title: Measurements
sets.description: Any of: traffic: Delivery, RTT and one-way delay overall and per hop count, offered and delivered throughput; queues: Per node: queue depths, drops, MAC retries, channel-access failures, frames relayed; mesh: Topology: parents, depths, orphans, parent changes, RPL control messages; power: Per node: charge and average current in the phase, by state (needs POWER); medium: Frames, airtime and reception outcomes of the radio medium

settle_s.title: Settle
settle_s.description: Time after the start not measured (s)

end.title: End
end.description: When the phase ends: after_s alone (a fixed duration, the default 60 s), or a condition with a cap max_s

is.description: immediately: true at once; time: virtual time reached; elapsed: time since the reference (the previous phase's end for a start, the phase's start for an end); formed: the network has joined; node_event: a node joined, changed or lost its parent, restarted; repaired: every node cut off by the last disruption has a route again; metric: a measured value compared with a threshold; all / any: a combination

block_formed.description: Wait until the network has formed (all routers ready) and no parent changed for stable_s

use.title: Block

stable_s.title: Stable for
stable_s.description: No parent change for this long (s)

timeout_s.title: Timeout
timeout_s.description: Start anyway after this long (s), flagged

block_probe.title: Per-hop RTT probe
block_probe.description: A light load, its RTT, delay and delivery per hop count: the baseline of later phases

use.title: Block
use.description: A light load, its RTT, delay and delivery per hop count: the baseline of later phases

rate_pps.title: Rate
rate_pps.description: Offered packets/s, whole network (default: one packet per router every 30 s, at most 0.5 packets/s)

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: up: routers to border router; down: border router to each router; mcast: border router to a group; p2p: router to router. Up, down and p2p are echoed

block_capacity.title: Capacity search
block_capacity.description: Raise the load step by step until the RTT reaches factor x the baseline, the largest RTT a threshold, or the delivery falls below min_pdr; the capacity is the last load before that

use.title: Block
use.description: Raise the load step by step until the RTT reaches factor x the baseline, the largest RTT a threshold, or the delivery falls below min_pdr; the capacity is the last load before that

baseline.title: Baseline phase
baseline.description: The phase whose RTT is the reference

start_rate_pps.title: First rate
start_rate_pps.description: Packets/s of the first step (default: 2 x the baseline's)

mul.title: Step factor
mul.description: Rate multiplied by this at each step

settle_s.title: Settle
settle_s.description: Time at the new load before measuring (s)

rtt_metric.title: RTT metric
rtt_metric.description: The RTT compared with the baseline

rtt_factor.title: RTT factor
rtt_factor.description: Saturated when the RTT reaches this x the baseline

max_rtt_ms.title: RTT ceiling
max_rtt_ms.description: Saturated when the largest RTT reaches this (ms)

min_pdr.title: Delivery floor
min_pdr.description: Saturated when the delivery ratio falls below this

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: up: routers to border router; down: border router to each router; mcast: border router to a group; p2p: router to router. Up, down and p2p are echoed

block_interference.title: Interference
block_interference.description: An external interferer from the start of the phase, under a share of the capacity found

use.title: Block
use.description: An external interferer from the start of the phase, under a share of the capacity found

interferer_name.title: Interferer name
interferer_name.description: Its name, to remove it later

block_recovery.title: Recovery
block_recovery.description: Remove the interferer (if any) at the same load and measure until the RTT is back near the baseline

use.title: Block
use.description: Remove the interferer (if any) at the same load and measure until the RTT is back near the baseline

interferer_name.title: Interferer name
interferer_name.description: The interferer removed ("all": every one; "": none)

within.title: Back within
within.description: Ends when the RTT is at most this x the baseline

block_node_failure.title: Node failure
block_node_failure.description: Power off nodes (default: the hop-1 router with the largest subtree) under a share of the capacity, and measure until the mesh is repaired

use.title: Block
use.description: Power off nodes (default: the hop-1 router with the largest subtree) under a share of the capacity, and measure until the mesh is repaired

label.title: Label
label.description: Name of the failed nodes, for a later restart

capacity_phase.title: Capacity phase
capacity_phase.description: Where the capacity comes from ("": keep the load)

e2e.title: End to end

block_node_restart.title: Node restart
block_node_restart.description: Start the failed nodes again (fresh instances) and measure until they are ready again

use.title: Block
